description:
Goal

Enum.with_index callable mappers retain their exact semantic identity through shared recursive activations and native lowering. The checked-in enum_map_family fixture matches its 20-line oracle through interp, JIT, and AOT without forcing omitted lanes or selecting a mapper from an invented input combination.

Signal

The investigation proved two sequential losses. First, artifact materialization paired a one-clause specialized executable with the unspecialized global dispatch graph, re-demanding a direct callable lane that transport correctly omitted. Second, after that is refined, combined mapper roots still fail because exact recursive input rows are joined column-by-column into Cartesian combinations before semantic analysis, collapsing callable targets that were precise upstream. Isolated roots pass, which distinguishes the correlation loss from native registry, body, continuation, or ABI identity.

Strategy

Complete the two atomic children in dependency order. First preserve dispatcher-calculated clauses and failure reachability as one EntryReachability fact and refine direct entry from it. Then preserve recursive activation inputs as correlated alternatives and analyze each row independently. Only refine authoritative upstream facts; do not force values live, reverse-engineer targets downstream, introduce provenance tags, seal a session, or add a compensating selector. Remove obsolete pointwise joins and stale deferrals as the corrected model makes them unnecessary.

Acceptance

Both children are folded and independently verified. enum_map_family is undeferred and exactly matches its oracle on interp, run, and build. Structural tests cover direct-entry refinement, retained dynamic dispatch, correlated recursive rows, publisher replacement/withdrawal, stale-target retraction, and bounded convergence. Full library, targeted fixture matrix, formatting, strict clippy, and documentation pass warning-free.
title: Preserve Enum.with_index callable mapper input through native lowering
